title: Stage 5 screw connections
suptitle: R_hip_pitch_to_roll_roll_flip (yellow Stage 5, pitch link): land on the ST3025 wheel face, arms on the measured roll horn / idler faces with a 0.10 mm running fit, rear top corner chamfered clear of the back shell

sections.title: SECTION A-A at y 2 (pitch axis, wheel screws 1 / 4), seen from -y
SECTION B-B at z 190 (roll axis, horn / idler screws), seen from +z

body:
mass 11.52 g PAHT-CF (was 12.40) + 12 steel sleeves 4.50 g (was 4.68)
mating faces measured (holes open inside them): horn y -12.0, idler y 25.25,
  wheel x 61.0; U inside 37.45 vs the 37.25 stack (was 36.60: 0.65 interference)
screws (stack = L - 0.5 - reference, from the defined holes):
  4 x M3x12 into the ST3025 wheel: engaged 2.935-2.95 of 2.95
    (land on the wheel face, hub recess r 6.0 open into the sleeve bores)
  4 x M3x8 horn / 4 x M3x8 idler: 0.10 mm free gap per side, the screws
    close it: engaged 2.5 / 2.1 clamped (2.4 / 2.0 free); sleeves 4.6 / 5.15
  sleeve bores teardropped (print up -x); arm-to-plate gussets 2.5
gaps: H-cage plates 1.45 mm (roll -45..25; was 1.29); roll case 0.60;
  Stage 6 green 1.20 (library); center_back_shell 0.75 over pitch -58..45 x
  yaw -30..30 (was 83.5 mm3 at pitch 45 / yaw -30): rear chamfer y 19.5..31.5
FEM (roll_flip_checks, layer x), min p99 strength ratio, roll stall:
  Bambu PAHT-CF 3.41 (was 3.61), legacy PETG-CF 2.51 (was 2.70);
  without the rear chamfer 3.64 / 2.69; peak 86.7 MPa at the front arm root
  (was 81-98 at the hub-flat corner, now r 1.5); press support 89-93 %
